player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}. You are playing the Memory Game.
Your goal is to match more pairs of cards on the board, than your opponent.
On your turn, select two cards to flip by entering the row and column numbers of the first and second card respectively like '[0 1 1 0]', where the first card is in row 0 and column 1, and the second card is in row 1 and column 0.
If the two cards match, you get a point and the cards remain face up. If they do not match, the cards are flipped back face down, e.g. '.'.
The game ends when all pairs have been matched.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Player {player_id} did not respond with a valid direction in square brackets.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Invalid move. Player {player_id} selected an out-of-bounds position.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Invalid move. Player {player_id} selected the same card twice.
invalid_move.already_matched: Invalid move. Player {player_id} selected one or both cards that have already been matched.

game_message.cards_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] match!
game_message.cards_no_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} do not match. Cards at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] are {pos1} and {pos2} respectively.

outcome.draw: Both players matched the same number of pairs of cards.
outcome.turn_limit: Mwaka wa turn limit uwakilwa. Lelo game yakwata. Player 0 akwelenga {score_0} point, Player 1 akwelenga {score_1} point.
